div.p: Friction Clothing is a men's streetwear store at The Dome Mall in Warrens, Barbados. The looks on this site pair graphic tees, denim, sets and footwear.

img.alt: Black graphic tee, black ripped denim and pink-and-black sneakers laid flat
Grey graphic tee, blue denim, brown cap and sneakers
Rust graphic tee, light denim and copper-toned sneakers
Yellow graphic tee, blue denim and yellow sneakers

article.p: The newest looks are grouped under New Arrivals in the Shop menu.
Each photo shows a full look. Items may be sold separately, so message Friction to confirm which pieces, sizes and prices are available.
Find Friction at The Dome Mall, Warrens, or send a WhatsApp message about availability and sizing.
